records.text: Nevada law allows girls at Courage House Nevada to remain until age 21 rather than leave at 18.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: and they specifically outline how excited they are that Nevada has changed its laws. which means that they don't have to leave on their 18th birthday, that those girls can now stay until they're 21.

verification.notes: Local reporting says Courage House Nevada residents may live there until age 21, and Nevada law recognizes under-21 psychiatric residential services. The stronger causal claim that Nevada law specifically creates this program rule, contrasted with mandatory departure at 18, is not established.

records.text: Nevada, particularly Las Vegas and Reno, works on behalf of Tel Aviv and controls Washington, D.C. through a gambling empire.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Unless you're a conspiracy theorist like me and you've come to the realization that Nevada, in particular Vegas, Reno, working on behalf of Tel Aviv, they're actually the people that are running Washington, D.C. We live in a gambling empire. ... That is what America is controlled by.

verification.notes: This is a sweeping geopolitical conspiracy allegation. Current searches found no competent evidence that Nevada, Las Vegas, and Reno collectively work for Tel Aviv or that a gambling empire controls Washington, D.C.; the entities and mechanism are not defined tightly enough for a factual test.

records.text: Turning Point Action has many job openings in Arizona, Nevada, and New Hampshire.
records.speaker: Tyler Bowyer

appearances.snippet: Last thing I'll say is this. At Turning Point Action, we have a ton of jobs posting in Arizona, Nevada, and New Hampshire.

verification.notes: Turning Point Action's current official careers page lists a large number of ballot-chase and administrative openings in Arizona, Nevada, and New Hampshire, directly confirming the substance of Bowyer's statement.
